experiment: Phase B v4_csa: learned compressor on the passkey probe
model_selection: v5.78 round 4 (16x curriculum): start from the v5.61 ratio-4 compressor (MLP carried over, position bias reset to zero), then train at ratio 16. Chosen on the separate validation stream (seed 2000, 150 trials) at L=128 and L=512, never on the evaluation stream: zero-shot 0.560/0.667; fine-tune lr 1e-2/2400 0.487/0.573, 3e-3/2400 0.587/0.700, 1e-3/2400 0.560/0.667, 3e-3/4800 0.607/0.753 -> chosen, 1e-3/9600 0.553/0.727, 3e-3/9600 0.620/0.720, 3e-3/19200 0.600/0.720. The v5.60 16x compressor trained from the zero init scored 0.387/0.380 on the same stream.
note: only the compressor is trained (end-to-end readout loss, train seed stream and L=128); q/k/v/out/indexer stay identity-wired and frozen; evaluated on the A/B seed-0 stream at longer L

oracle_ceiling.note: measuring stick, not a method: each chunk pooled onto its largest-norm token
